title: SOC-60 Filament Admin Insights and Read-Only View Improvements
scopeExpansion: TASK-011 reconciles the existing backend architecture RBAC table with AdminRole and AdminAuthorizationSeeder because the current document omits the backups reader and operator roles.
prerequisites: Filament 5.10.1 and the existing Admin module structure remain the implementation baseline.
No schema change or new dependency is required; use existing User, AccountStatusChange, ActivityLog, BackupListingData, and MediaLibrary models/services.
For TASK-007 and TASK-010, Debugbar storage must be enabled and an authorized local Admin session must be able to render both post-image tables with representative media-backed rows.
nonGoals: Do not add CRUD or moderation actions for users, posts, comments, replies, or backups; preserve only the existing account lifecycle and backup operations.
Do not add roles, permissions, migrations, or third-party packages.
Do not replace or redesign the existing registration summary and registration chart.
Do not add a general-purpose analytics framework or an absolute response-time performance gate.
contracts: AdminPanelProvider discovers widgets from app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Widgets; preserve the registration widgets and the app's existing per-resource hierarchy.

Dashboard user metrics require admin.users.viewAny, activity metrics require admin.activity.viewAny, and backup metrics require admin.backups.view. Filter each card and its link independently before querying its source.
Activity metrics use a fixed seven-day window and event labels from ActivityLogEventCatalog; never expose activity properties or reconstructed content.

The backup page widget receives the same cached listing from BackupManagement::getBackupListing() through Filament Page::getWidgetData(); dashboard backup summaries cache aggregate-only data for five minutes after authorization.
User detail continues to rely on UserPolicy. Its lifecycle addition is a 30-day status-change count so it does not repeat the current status infolist or disclose reasons.
The user avatar uses UserImageType::PROFILE_PICTURE, User::DEFAULT_PROFILE_PICTURE_PATH, meaningful alt text, and eager-loaded media.
The reply action is read-only and resolves edited_at and repliedToUser as optional context while keeping the reply scoped to its selected parent.
Posts media optimization preserves the media collection, supported page sizes, fallback, alt text, selected relation keys, and the shared Post detail route.
existingCodeLeverage: app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Widgets/RegistrationSummaryWidget.php and RegistrationsChart.php provide the dashboard baseline.
app/Modules/Admin/Services/BackupManagementService.php returns BackupListingData and enforces backup permissions; BackupManagement caches its listing per page instance.

ActivityLogResource, ActivityLogsTable, UserActivityOverview, AccountStatusChangesRelationManager, UsersTable, RepliesRelationManager, PostsTable, and PostsRelationManager are existing extension points.
Relevant focused tests already exist under app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/ for dashboard, activity, backups, users, posts, and replies.

tasks.title: Add permission-aware operational metrics to the Admin dashboard
tasks.description: Create one compact operational widget discovered from the existing Admin widget directory. Include account status and recent status changes, recent activity, and backup health. Keep each metric and its destination link behind the permission for its source. Cache only the dashboard backup summary for five minutes; do not cache or expose backup filenames.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing registration summary and chart remain available; the new widget adds at most three compact cards: active/suspended accounts with seven-day status changes, seven-day activity count, and latest backup age with available/total count.

The account card/link requires admin.users.viewAny, activity requires admin.activity.viewAny, and backups requires admin.backups.view; without a source permission its query/service call and rendered values/link are absent.
Zero activity or no backups renders explicit zero/unavailable states, and a failure in one source does not prevent the other permitted cards or dashboard from rendering.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Widgets/Opera: Render per-source permission-gated operational metrics and five-minute backup summary cache.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Registr: Cover the preserved registration widgets, metric values, permission combinations, and missing-source states.

tasks.title: Add an aggregate summary to the activity log page
tasks.description: Add a small read-only stats widget to the activity log listing. Use a fixed seven-day window and the existing event catalog for the distribution; aggregate at the database instead of loading event properties or content.
acceptanceCriteria: The listing shows the seven-day event total and an event-type distribution using the existing readable event labels.
The widget is available only on the already-authorized activity page and does not render activity properties, comment text, or post content.
An empty log renders zero counts and an empty state without errors; existing table filters, pagination, and read-only behavior remain.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Resources/Act: Compute and render aggregate event statistics.
Attach the summary widget to the existing list page.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Resourc: Verify counts, labels, empty data, and preservation of the authorized read-only page.

tasks.title: Add a summary widget to backup management
tasks.description: Add a read-only backup summary using the listing already loaded by BackupManagement. Pass the page's cached listing through Filament's getWidgetData() so rendering the widget does not repeat the remote storage scan.
acceptanceCriteria: The page summary shows available and missing counts, the latest available backup time/age, and total size when every size is available.
The widget consumes the page's cached BackupListingData through getWidgetData(); the table, infolist, and widget share one listing per Livewire page instance.
An empty or unhealthy destination renders an explicit state, and a user without admin.backups.view cannot open the page or see summary data; create/download actions keep their current permissions.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Pages/Backups: Render summary cards from page-provided backup data.
Attach the widget and pass the existing cached listing via getWidgetData().
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Pages/B: Cover summary values, empty/unhealthy storage, access control, and single-listing reuse.

tasks.title: Add a non-duplicative account lifecycle indicator to user details
tasks.description: Extend UserActivityOverview with one aggregate: account status changes during the last 30 days. Keep current status in the existing infolist and detailed change records in their existing relation manager; do not repeat reasons or add mutation actions.
acceptanceCriteria: The user detail shows the selected user's 30-day status-change count alongside the existing activity metrics.
Counts are scoped to the selected user and the current user-view authorization; no reason text or unrelated account data appears.
A user with no status changes displays zero, while existing suspend/reactivate actions and the status infolist remain unchanged.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Resources/Use: Add the status-change aggregate to the existing widget.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Resourc: Verify user scoping, 30-day boundaries, zero state, and authorization.

tasks.title: Show accessible profile avatars in the users table
tasks.description: Add the user's profile picture to UsersTable from the existing MediaLibrary profile collection. Reuse its configured fallback and eager-load media so the new column does not add one query per row.
acceptanceCriteria: A user with a profile picture renders a small avatar with descriptive alt text; a user without one renders the configured default profile image with an accessible name.
The users table continues to paginate and filter correctly, and profile media is loaded without query growth per displayed user.
The column does not expose or change any user fields or actions beyond the requested picture.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Resources/Use: Add the profile image column, fallback, alt text, and media eager loading.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Resourc: Verify populated and empty media cases, accessibility label, permissions, and bounded queries.

tasks.title: Open full reply context in a read-only modal
tasks.description: Add a row-level read action to RepliesRelationManager. The modal shows full reply text, author, creation time, optional edited time, and optional replied-to user; it must not provide form fields or mutation actions.
acceptanceCriteria: The modal displays the complete selected reply, author, and creation time; edited_at and repliedToUser are shown only when present.
A reply with no edit or mention renders without placeholder errors, and a missing replied-to user does not break the modal.
The selected reply remains scoped to the current comment and the table remains read-only apart from opening this modal.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Resources/Com: Add the authorized read-only row action and modal content.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Resourc: Verify complete content, optional context, record scoping, and no mutation actions.

tasks.title: Capture the pre-optimization image-table baseline
tasks.description: Create a performance evidence note and measure both existing post-image tables before changing them. Use the same local dataset for both captures: the Posts list and a user's Posts relation with representative media-backed rows. Record row count, request ID, response duration, total query count, and repeated media-query shapes from Debugbar; omit user names and post content.
acceptanceCriteria: The new note records the environment, row count, request ID, duration, total queries, and repeated media-query groups for both pages.
The note contains no personal data, post content, credentials, or backup information; no baseline values are invented when a request was not captured.
If either route has no representative captured request, capture it with an authorized local Admin session before TASK-008 or TASK-009 begins.

fileRoles.docs/development/admin-post-image-perfor: Store reproducible before/after measurements for both image tables.

tasks.title: Remove per-row media loading from the Posts list
tasks.description: After TASK-007 establishes the baseline, optimize the MediaLibrary-backed ImageColumn in PostsTable. Eager-load the media relation while preserving the current image collection, pagination, 64-pixel display, fallback, alt text, and list behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The Posts list resolves media without a query per row at both the default and larger supported page sizes.
Posts with and without media preserve their current image and fallback behavior, and filters, author data, sorting, and pagination remain intact.
The regression test verifies bounded media-query counts as row count increases and fails if a per-record media query returns.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Resources/Pos: Eager-load post media for the list's image column without changing display behavior.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Resourc: Add media-query regression coverage across row counts and preserve image fallback assertions.

tasks.title: Remove per-row media loading from user post details
tasks.description: After TASK-007 establishes the baseline, optimize the PostsRelationManager image column. Preserve the required selected post keys, relation scoping, pagination, existing MediaLibrary collection, 64-pixel display, fallback, and alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: The user detail loads post media with a bounded query count rather than one media query for each displayed post.
The selected post key and user_id remain available to the relation query, and posts still link to the shared Post detail page.
The regression test covers media present and missing and detects query growth when the relation page size increases.

fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Filament/Resources/Use: Eager-load media while preserving the owner-scoped select and table behavior.
fileRoles.app/Modules/Admin/Tests/Filament/Resourc: Add query-growth regression coverage and verify existing image and navigation behavior.

tasks.title: Record post-image performance after optimization
tasks.description: After TASK-008 and TASK-009, capture the same pages, row counts, environment, and Debugbar collectors as TASK-007. Update the evidence note with before/after query counts and durations, and explain any timing variance without imposing an absolute millisecond threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: The note contains comparable before/after measurements for both tables, including row counts, query totals, media-query shapes, and request durations.
The final captures show no per-row media-query group; if one remains, the task reports it and the issue is not ready to close.
The note identifies environment and timing variance and contains no user or post content.

fileRoles.docs/development/admin-post-image-perfor: Append comparable post-optimization measurements and conclusion.

tasks.title: Reconcile the Admin RBAC catalog in backend architecture docs
tasks.description: As the adjacent EXPANSION item, update the existing backend architecture role table to match the current AdminRole enum and AdminAuthorizationSeeder. The document currently omits the backups reader and operator roles even though CLAUDE.md and the code catalog include them.
acceptanceCriteria: The role table lists every current AdminRole and describes the backups reader as view-only and the backups operator as view/create/download.
The documented role-permission bundles match AdminRole, AdminPermission, AdminAuthorizationSeeder, and CLAUDE.md without changing RBAC code.
The existing read-only/resource authorization explanation remains accurate after the table update.

fileRoles.docs/architecture/backend.md: Reconcile the existing RBAC reference table with the current code catalog.

failureModes: A user sees an operational metric or deep link without permission for its source; the widget must omit the card before the query/service call.
An empty activity log or backup destination produces a missing/undefined statistic instead of an explicit empty value.
A remote backup listing failure breaks the entire dashboard or creates a second storage scan on the backup page.
A reply without edited_at or repliedToUser breaks the modal, or a row action resolves a reply outside its owner comment.
Missing profile/post media renders a broken image or inaccessible link instead of the configured fallback and alt text.
Lazy MediaLibrary lookups add one query per table row; query-growth tests and before/after Debugbar evidence must detect this.
shipCut: The feature slices can be reviewed independently, but SOC-60 remains open until tasks TASK-001 through TASK-010 pass. Do not merge either media optimization before its pre-change baseline exists, and do not close the issue until the final evidence note compares both tables. TASK-011 is the adjacent documentation reconciliation and does not block the UI slices.

testCoverageMap.coverage: Preserved registration widgets, source-specific dashboard data/visibility, empty sources, and missing backup summary.
Seven-day event aggregates, readable distribution, empty state, and read-only authorized listing.
Backup counts/latest age/size, empty or unhealthy state, permission boundary, and cached listing reuse.
Selected-user lifecycle count, 30-day boundary, zero count, and visibility.
Profile image, configured fallback, alt text, and bounded media query count.
Full modal context, absent optional fields, parent scoping, and read-only action set.
Posts table image/fallback behavior and query count across row counts.
User-post image/fallback behavior, relation scope, and query count across row counts.
